94236648.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 L · Portion: 30 g per plate (33 plates)
c: Roast bones 220 °C 40 min; soak the 80 g marrow (from 2 canoe-cut bones) in salted iced water, then dice.
Colour shallots, garlic, mushrooms in the fat; deglaze Madeira and wine; reduce to glaze.
Add stock and bones; simmer 3 h; pass; reduce to nappe.
To order: warm jus, whisk in diced marrow off the heat (rich, glossy), drop of vinegar.
94236648.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
94236648.al: 9 Celery (veal stock) · 14 Sulphites (madeira, red wine, sherry vinegar). Contains sulphites; celery if the veal stock contains it.

3eec3b61.yl: Yield: ≈ 120 g · Portion: 1 g per plate (100 plates)
c: Peel; slice 1 mm on mandoline; dehydrate 55 °C 12 h until snapping.
Grind fine; sieve; mix with citric acid; store with silica.
3eec3b61.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.
3eec3b61.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

0f7419ea.yl: Yield: ≈ 250 g · Portion: 5 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Rinse olives; dry well; dehydrate 60 °C 12 h until brittle.
Blitz with rosemary to soil; toast panko in oil until golden; mix.
0f7419ea.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.

8cf93c27.yl: Yield: 60 shards · Portion: 6 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Soak linseed in water 15 min to gel; stir in the rest.
Spread 1.5 mm on silicone; bake 150 °C 40 min; break into shards; dry 10 min more.
8cf93c27.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient 3 days; re-crisp 150 °C 2 min.
8cf93c27.al: 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Vegan; gluten-free. Contains sesame.

87b61e4b.yl: Yield: ≈ 700 g · Portion: 20 g per plate (35 plates)
c: Halve onions skin-on; char cut side in a dry cast-iron pan until black (15 min).
Peel; slice; cook with oil, butter, sugar 40 min to deep caramel; add vinegar and stock; reduce dry.
Blend very smooth; adjust to a glossy black with a pinch of charcoal; season.
87b61e4b.st: Blast chill; piping bags or vac-pack; 0–5 °C 3 days, −18 °C 1 month (re-blend after thawing). Reheat to 75 °C.
87b61e4b.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (sherry vinegar). Contains milk, sulphites. Vegan with vegetable stock and oil.

4d0086db.yl: Yield: ≈ 500 ml · Portion: 30 g per plate (16 plates)
c: Dill oil: blend dill with oil at 70 °C 3 min; strain through coffee filter; chill.
Season buttermilk with crème fraîche, lemon, salt; serve cold, broken with drops of dill oil on the plate.
4d0086db.st: Hold 0–5 °C, use within 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
4d0086db.al: 7 Milk (buttermilk, crème fraîche 30%). Vegetarian. Contains milk.

1bbe6292.yl: Yield: ≈ 1.2 kg · Portion: 40 g per plate (30 plates)
c: Dice peeled celeriac 2 cm; simmer in milk and cream covered 25 min until very soft.
Blend celeriac with enough liquor 4 min at high speed; stream in brown butter; season; pass through a fine tamis.
1bbe6292.st: Blast chill; piping bags or vac-pack; 0–5 °C 3 days, −18 °C 1 month (re-blend after thawing). Reheat to 75 °C.
1bbe6292.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 35%, butter) · 9 Celery (celeriac). Contains celery, milk.

67066e8f.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 L · Portion: 30 g per plate (33 plates)
c: Roast bones 220 °C 45 min; sweat onion, garlic, apple in the roasting fat.
Deglaze with vinegar, juice, wine; reduce by half; add stock; simmer 3 h; pass.
Reduce to nappe; infuse sage 5 min; whisk in mustard and butter to order.
67066e8f.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
67066e8f.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 10 Mustard (wholegrain mustard) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains mustard, milk, sulphites.

3e8497c4.yl: Yield: ≈ 250 g + 400 ml oil · Portion: 4 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Start in cold oil; heat to 140 °C; stir until pale gold (≈ 15 min), they darken after draining.
Drain on paper; salt. Strain the oil: shallot oil for dressings.
3e8497c4.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient 3 days; re-crisp 150 °C 2 min.
3e8497c4.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

e5e9d48e.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 L · Portion: 30 g per plate (33 plates)
c: Chop carcasses small; roast in duck fat in a rondeau to deep golden; pour off fat.
Add shallots and garlic, colour; deglaze port then wine; reduce to a glaze.
Add stock; simmer 2 h skimming; infuse juniper, zest, thyme 10 min; pass.
Reduce to nappe (≈ 1 L); to order mount 10 g butter per 150 ml; 2 drops vinegar.
e5e9d48e.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
e5e9d48e.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal stock) · 14 Sulphites (port wine, red wine, sherry vinegar). Contains milk, sulphites; celery if the veal stock contains it.

790a4805.yl: Yield: ≈ 5 L · Portion: 100 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Veal bones 6 kg + trotters for body
Roast bones 220 °C 50 min, turning, to deep brown (not burnt).
Add mirepoix last 20 min; smear tomato paste, pincé 5 min.
Deglaze tray with wine; cover bones with cold water; bring up slowly; skim.
Simmer at 85–90 °C for 10–12 h, never boil; add sachet last 2 h.
Strain through chinois then muslin; chill; lift fat. Target: set to a soft jelly when cold.
790a4805.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
790a4805.al: 9 Celery (celery) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Contains celery and sulphites (wine).

025e8242.yl: Yield: ≈ 120 g · Portion: 2 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Dry leaves completely; fry at 160 °C 5–10 s until the bubbling stops; drain on paper.
Pat capers dry; fry 170 °C 1 min until opened and crisp.
025e8242.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient same day; re-crisp 150 °C 2 min.
025e8242.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

c8520243.yl: Yield: ≈ 600 g · Portion: 10 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Juice skin-on apples with lemon immediately (stays green); strain; weigh 550 g.
Shear gellan and sugar into the cold juice; bring to 90 °C 1 min; set in a tray 20 min.
Blend the set gel 2 min to a smooth fluid gel; pass; bottle.
c8520243.st: Squeeze bottles, 0–5 °C 5 days; blend again if it weeps.
c8520243.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

57607632.yl: Yield: ≈ 2 L · Portion: 100 g per plate (20 plates)
c: 2 hocks → ≈ 3 L broth + 600 g picked meat
Soak hocks 6 h; cover with cold water; simmer 3 h with veg; pick meat for garnish; strain broth; chill; de-fat.
Mix raft ingredients with 500 ml cold broth; whisk into the rest; bring slowly to 80 °C stirring until the raft forms.
Make a chimney; barely simmer 45 min; ladle through muslin. Season; serve with peas, ham and parsley.
57607632.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
57607632.al: 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 9 Celery (celery). Contains celery, eggs, pork.

58f05715.yl: Yield: ≈ 500 g · Portion: 10 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Brown butter; chill until set; dice.
Rub into flour, hazelnut, parmesan, thyme, salt; freeze 20 min.
Bake on silicone 160 °C 18 min, breaking every 6 min, until evenly golden.
58f05715.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.
58f05715.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter, parmesan) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts). Contains gluten, milk, nuts (hazelnut).

5a966cf3.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 kg · Portion: 35 g per plate (28 plates)
c: Peel into lemon water; slice; sweat in butter with thyme 10 min (no colour).
Add milk and cream; simmer 20 min; blend smooth; finish with hazelnut oil; tamis. Keep skins for crisps.
5a966cf3.st: Blast chill; piping bags or vac-pack; 0–5 °C 3 days, −18 °C 1 month (re-blend after thawing). Reheat to 75 °C.
5a966cf3.al: 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (hazelnut oil). Contains milk, nuts (hazelnut oil).

165dc75f.yl: Yield: ≈ 2 L · Portion: 60 g per plate (33 plates)
c: Roast shells in oil in a wide pan, crushing, until red and fragrant (10 min).
Add veg, tomato paste; flambé with cognac; add wine and water.
Simmer 40 min only; crush through a chinois; infuse tarragon 10 min; pass through muslin.
165dc75f.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
165dc75f.al: 2 Crustaceans (langoustine shells & heads) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains crustaceans, sulphites.

f3fc671b.yl: Yield: ≈ 500 ml liquid · Portion: 10 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Ratio: 0.5–0.8% soy lecithin on liquid weight
Use any flavourful thin liquid (stock, citrus juice, dashi, milk); season it strongly.
Add lecithin; at 45–55 °C hold a stick blender at the surface, tilting the jug, to draw in air.
Rest 1 min; spoon off only the stable bubbles. Re-blend between plates.
f3fc671b.st: Make to order, or hold at 60–65 °C ≤ 2 h; siphon bases 0–5 °C 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
f3fc671b.al: 4 Fish (fish stock) · 6 Soybeans (soy lecithin powder) · 7 Milk (butter). Contains fish, milk, soy (base shown: fish).

0926ab8e.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 L · Portion: 60 g per plate (16 plates)
c: Sweat shallots; colour mushrooms hard; deglaze Madeira; add stock and soaked porcini; simmer 20 min; add cream; blend; pass.
To order: heat 200 ml with milk and lecithin to 60 °C; blend at the surface to a thick foam; spoon over; drops of truffle oil.
0926ab8e.st: Make to order, or hold at 60–65 °C ≤ 2 h; siphon bases 0–5 °C 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
0926ab8e.al: 6 Soybeans (soy lecithin powder) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%, milk 3%) · 14 Sulphites (madeira). Vegetarian. Contains milk, soy, sulphites.

bf39cdc7.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 L · Portion: 30 g per plate (33 plates)
c: Roast mushrooms and veg 220 °C 40 min until very dark; tomato paste last 10 min.
Deglaze with wine; add water, soaked porcini, kombu (remove kombu at 60 °C).
Simmer 1 h; press through chinois; reduce by ⅔ with soy and black garlic; blend; set lightly with slaked starch.
bf39cdc7.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
bf39cdc7.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Vegan. Contains soy, sulphites.

1ff79933.yl: Yield: ≈ 400 g · Portion: 8 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Slice mushrooms; roast 160 °C 60 min until dry and dark; blitz with porcini to powder.
Rub with flour, hazelnut, malt, sugar, cold butter to crumbs; bake 160 °C 15 min, stirring; cool; break to soil.
1ff79933.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.
1ff79933.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, dark malt powder) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts). Contains gluten, milk, nuts (hazelnut).

3e737f77.yl: Yield: ≈ 150 g · Portion: 1 g per plate (100 plates)
c: Toast nori over a flame 5 s per side; dry kombu 120 °C 20 min.
Grind with toasted sesame, salt and sugar to a coarse seasoning.
3e737f77.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.

d8a1bb3a.yl: Yield: ≈ 350 g · Portion: 10 g per plate (35 plates)
c: Shuck oysters, keep juice; blend meat, juice, lemon, mustard 30 s.
Stream in oil to a thick, glossy emulsion; pass; keep in a squeeze bottle on ice.
d8a1bb3a.al: 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 12 Molluscs (oysters). Contains molluscs, mustard.

377d910a.yl: Yield: 40 tuiles · Portion: 5 g per plate (40 plates)
c: Mix cheese, flour, pepper; sprinkle 5 g discs Ø 7 cm on silicone.
Bake 180 °C 6–7 min until lacy gold; shape over a pin while warm, or keep flat.
377d910a.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient 3 days; re-crisp 150 °C 2 min.
377d910a.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (parmesan). Contains gluten, milk. Vegetarian if rennet-free cheese is used.

020fac37.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 kg · Portion: 35 g per plate (28 plates)
c: Peel; remove woody core; slice; sweat in butter 8 min.
Add milk, cream, scraped vanilla; simmer 20 min; blend 4 min; tamis; season.
020fac37.st: Blast chill; piping bags or vac-pack; 0–5 °C 3 days, −18 °C 1 month (re-blend after thawing). Reheat to 75 °C.

a1aadbcc.yl: Yield: ≈ 60 pillows · Portion: 6 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Use old, low-moisture potatoes; cut even rectangles 3 × 5 cm, 3 mm thick on a mandoline; dry with a cloth (do not rinse).
First fry 150 °C in small batches, shaking the basket, until the slices blister and the edges swell (6–7 min); drain; cool on a rack (can hold 4 h).
Second fry 190 °C 30 s: they puff into pillows; drain; salt; serve within 10 min. Discard unpuffed slices or use as crisps.
a1aadbcc.st: Airtight with silica gel, first-fried slices ambient 4 h; puff to order.
a1aadbcc.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

a2ee5bfa.yl: Yield: 1 L siphon · Portion: 40 g per plate (22 plates)
c: Boil peeled potatoes; drain; pass through a ricer while hot.
Whisk in hot milk, cream, butter; season strongly; pass through a fine chinois (no lumps: they block the nozzle).
Fill siphon ⅔; charge twice; shake; hold in a 65 °C bain-marie. Finish with brown butter and chives.
a2ee5bfa.st: Make to order, or hold at 60–65 °C ≤ 2 h; siphon bases 0–5 °C 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
a2ee5bfa.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 35%, butter). Vegetarian. Contains milk.

561050bd.yl: Yield: ≈ 800 ml · Portion: 25 g per plate (32 plates)
c: Soak frames 1 h in iced water; dry; roast 220 °C 20 min until golden (no longer: bitterness).
Sweat shallots, mushrooms; add wines, reduce to syrup; add bones and stock; simmer 30 min only.
Pass; reduce to nappe; mount with butter to order.
561050bd.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
561050bd.al: 4 Fish (fish bones) · 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine, port wine). Contains fish, milk, sulphites.

4e208ee4.yl: Yield: ≈ 300 g · Portion: 5 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Slice 1 mm on mandoline (lengthways for parsnip); keep colours separate; rinse artichoke and parsnip; dry very well.
Fry 150 °C in small batches until bubbling stops (beetroot last); drain; salt.
4e208ee4.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient 3 days; re-crisp 150 °C 2 min.
4e208ee4.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

526c9c45.yl: Yield: ≈ 400 g · Portion: 8 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Dry bread 120 °C 40 min; blitz to coarse crumbs.
Brown butter; toss crumbs with butter, malt, caraway, sugar, salt; bake 150 °C 15 min, stirring every 5 min.
526c9c45.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.
526c9c45.al: 1 Gluten (pumpernickel / rye bread, dark malt powder) · 7 Milk (butter). Contains gluten, milk.

22d24ae0.yl: Yield: ≈ 600 ml · Portion: 30 g per plate (20 plates)
c: Sweat shallots in butter; deglaze Madeira; reduce by ⅔.
Off heat add chopped truffle and truffle paste; infuse 10 min; mount with cold butter to order.
22d24ae0.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Add truffle after reheating; never boil.
22d24ae0.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal demi-glace) · 14 Sulphites (madeira). Contains milk, sulphites.

ab771f82.yl: Yield: ≈ 500 g · Portion: 8 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Warm juice with honey and thyme; infuse 10 min; strain.
Shear in agar; boil 1 min; set; blend smooth; pass.
ab771f82.st: Squeeze bottles, 0–5 °C 5 days; blend again if it weeps.
ab771f82.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegetarian (honey).

64850235.yl: Yield: ≈ 800 g · Portion: 30 g per plate (26 plates)
c: Char whole aubergines over flame or under salamander until collapsed (20 min); rest in a covered bowl 10 min.
Scoop flesh; hang in a sieve 30 min (remove bitter liquid).
Blend with miso, garlic, lemon, xanthan; stream in oil; season.
64850235.st: Blast chill; piping bags or vac-pack; 0–5 °C 3 days, −18 °C 1 month (re-blend after thawing). Reheat to 75 °C.

af50b2a6.yl: Yield: ≈ 400 ml · Portion: 25 g per plate (16 plates)
c: Cold-smoke diced butter 20 min in a smoking gun or hotel pan with smouldering chips; chill.
Reduce shallots, wine, vinegar to 2 tbsp; add cream; boil 30 s.
Whisk in smoked butter piece by piece at 65 °C; pass; season.
af50b2a6.st: Make to order, or hold at 60–65 °C ≤ 2 h; siphon bases 0–5 °C 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
af50b2a6.al: 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, white wine vinegar). Vegetarian. Contains milk, sulphites.

37536a80.yl: Yield: 60 crisps · Portion: 4 g per plate (60 plates)
c: Freeze the loaf 2 h; slice 1 mm on the slicer.
Brush with oil on parchment; weight with a second tray; bake 150 °C 12 min; salt.
37536a80.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient 3 days; re-crisp 150 °C 2 min.

d80cde96.yl: Yield: ≈ 400 ml · Portion: 25 g per plate (16 plates)
c: Sweat shallots with vadouvan 2 min; deglaze wine; add fish stock; reduce to 60 ml; add cream; boil.
Mount with cold butter at 65 °C; pass; lime and salt.
d80cde96.st: Make to order, or hold at 60–65 °C ≤ 2 h; siphon bases 0–5 °C 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
d80cde96.al: 4 Fish (fish stock) · 7 Milk (cream 35%, butter) · 10 Mustard (vadouvan spice blend) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains fish, milk, mustard (in vadouvan), sulphites.

d2028024.yl: Yield: ≈ 80 g · Portion: 1 g per plate (80 plates)
c: Use dark green leek tops and onion skins; dry 80 °C 4 h.
Char on a tray under a very hot salamander or in a 250 °C oven until black and brittle (not grey).
Cool; grind to powder; sieve; mix with salt.
d2028024.st: Airtight with silica gel, ambient; dry powders 2 weeks, fat-bound crumbs 5 days.
d2028024.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

f9cd8419.yl: Yield: ≈ 1 L · Portion: 30 g per plate (33 plates)
c: Roast trimmings hard in oil; add veg, colour.
Reduce wine by ¾ separately (keeps colour, removes harshness); add with stock to bones.
Simmer 3 h; pass; reduce to nappe with crushed juniper and pepper.
Finish: redcurrant jelly, chocolate (depth, not taste), butter; correct salt.
f9cd8419.st: Chill ≤ 5 °C within 90 min; 0–5 °C 3 days, or −18 °C 3 months in labelled 500 ml tubs. Finish and mount to order.
f9cd8419.al: 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 70%) · 7 Milk (dark chocolate 70%, butter) · 9 Celery (celery, veal stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Contains celery, milk, soy, sulphites.

832e9f16.yl: Yield: ≈ 600 ml · Portion: 40 g per plate (15 plates)
c: Sweat shallots; deglaze 150 ml vin jaune; reduce by ¾; add stock; reduce by half; add cream; simmer to nappe.
Sauté morels or mushrooms separately; add; finish with the last 50 ml vin jaune off the heat (aroma), lemon.
832e9f16.st: Make to order, or hold at 60–65 °C ≤ 2 h; siphon bases 0–5 °C 2 days; discard leftovers after service.
832e9f16.al: 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (vin jaune). Contains milk, sulphites.

5f704164.yl: Yield: ≈ 400 g · Portion: 8 g per plate (50 plates)
c: Boil water, sugar, agar, gellan 1 min; whisk in yuzu juice; set in a tray in the fridge.
Blend to a glossy fluid gel; pass; adjust with water if too firm.
5f704164.st: Squeeze bottles, 0–5 °C 5 days; blend again if it weeps.
5f704164.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.
